in_latin.name: Eudoxia
in_latin.meaning: Meaning is derived from Greek words εὐδοξία (eudoxia) meaning well-spoken of, reputation, fame
in_latin.long_meaning: Eudoxia is a name derived from Greek words εὐδοξία (eudoxia) meaning well-spoken of, reputation, fame. The name is also related to the Latin word doxa, meaning glory or fame. In Christian tradition, the name Eudoxia is associated with the concept of a good reputation and a virtuous life. It is also connected to the idea of being spoken well of by God and others, reflecting a positive and uplifting personality. In the early Christian church, the name Eudoxia was used to signify a devout and respected member of the community.
